modalLead: Rows, chips and fields in Config, the list views and the windows follow the theme, and five Config sections open with a clearer first paragraph.

items.text: Dark fills inside the views and windows follow the material. Rows, chips, option cards, fields and the drawings beside a setting no longer show as dark holes on a see-through Signature panel.
The / in the Bookmarks search box sits inside the field.
A clearer first paragraph in five sections. Monitoring, Unraid, Status page, Containers and AI Assistant now say what they are for before the settings.
